title: An alien pilot teaches Buchanan to fly a UFO
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of An alien pilot teaches Buchanan to fly a UFO, about unspecified at undisclosed, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The alien was there. He took me up front. He was the pilot. So, I tried it and I learned how to do it.
you know. And um so I tried it and I learned how to do it. Anyway, we landed at some place that was not Earth
tellings.difference: Adds the abduction from an East Texas country church parsonage in 1963-1965 and the landing at a place not on Earth.
tellings.link_reason: Buchanan's firsthand account of the alien pilot taking him up front and teaching him to fly the craft, the same encounter as the flying-lesson story.

as_told.title: Abduction from the East Texas parsonage and flying the craft
as_told.place_text: country church parsonage, East Texas; an off-Earth location
